annotations.title: Free SEO check of a website

description: Reads the public home page of a website and a few pages from its sitemap, the way a search engine does, and returns the SEO problems found (duplicate titles and descriptions, thin content, missing h1, noindex in sitemap, robots.txt, sitemap, http/www variants, compression, mixed content…), the Google snippet as it appears today and where Google cuts it, and the fixes the SEO Records corrector would apply. Free, about 10–20 seconds, nothing is stored. Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants

url.description: The website address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/
